limits: One predeclared seed42; no scaling-law inference or extrapolation.

Common-compute CE is locally linearly interpolated inside observed brackets; weights and raw endpoints are retained.
C is a same-shape component panel, not an iso-parameter comparison or full Foil/LOOM reproduction.
Native curves use the fixed approximately1M-label slice; complete10M-label HF endpoints are separate.
Each anchor matches non-embedding parameters, document-aware analytical compute and logical KV within reported residuals. This does not isolate a universal causal Loop effect.
Measured native walltime/GPUHr, analytical model FLOPs and reserved foreground time are separate quantities.
The original P1 strict full-network BF16-gradient comparison failure remains in inherited evidence; this gate does not relabel it passed.
Validated model-training geometry reaches two nodes/16H200/HSDP2x8. No claim of32-rank model training or EP/TP qualification.
No statistical significance, original private-paper reproduction, guaranteed SOTA or final winning recipe is established.
